target.expectedQuestionText: In a rate of reaction diagram, which of the curves represents the evolution of oxygen with time in the equation 2KClO3(s) → 2KCl(s) + 3O2(g)?
target.expectedOptionsJson: ["Curve starting at origin and plateauing at the top","Curve starting high and sloping down to plateau near zero","A straight diagonal line passing through the origin","A horizontal line parallel to the time axis"]
target.expectedExplanation: Even without seeing the specific image, understand the principle of a product curve. Oxygen is a product. At time zero, no reaction has happened, so the volume of oxygen is 0 (it starts at the origin). As the reaction proceeds quickly, the curve rises steeply. As the reactant (KClO3) gets used up, the rate slows down, causing the curve to level off and eventually become a flat plateau when the reaction stops.
